headline: Deploy {arm:atlas-m}. It is the only model that clears every quality gate and latency budget.
lede: {arm:atlas-m} clears all eleven declared gates across tasks while operating well inside the latency budget. Cheaper models fail on multi-turn troubleshooting and research quality.

slots.text: Adopt {arm:atlas-m} for the concierge chat assistant. It satisfies every quality floor and p95 latency limit across tasks.
{arm:atlas-l} breaches the latency budget in four of five tasks; {arm:brisk-s} and {arm:open-70b} fail multiple core quality gates.
{weakest.arm} meets {weakest.criterion} at {weakest.value|pct} against the {weakest.threshold|pct} gate, leaving zero margin. A wider trial is needed to confirm troubleshooting resolution stability.
Run an expanded troubleshooting benchmark on {arm:atlas-m} with double the case count to ensure issue resolution stays above the floor.

method.text: Choice comparison across four candidate models evaluated across five distinct task domains.
Overall quality evaluated via a calibrated judge with {judged.overall.calibration_ratings} ratings and {judged.overall.agreement|pct} agreement.
Eleven hard gates were defined across tasks covering quality floors and latency budgets.
Token usage priced at published list rates per 1,000 conversations.
